boards.name: Four Isles
boards.description: Four islands of six. Start on any; each other island you settle is worth 2 points.

boards.name: Fire and Ice
boards.description: A volcano on the home island and another beyond the icebergs. Eruptions damage the corner the die names.

boards.name: Jungle Coast
boards.description: Jungles yield discoveries that pay for development cards. Two jungle isles lie offshore.
